Account.description: A company or travel agent a reservation can be billed to.

credit_limit.description: In minor units of `currency`; `None` for no limit.

AccountContact.description: How to reach an account: every field optional, filled in as known.

AccountKind.description: Who a reservation may be billed to.

room_id.description: An active room of the booked type, free and unblocked on the stay's nights.

AssignedRoom.description: A stay's room after assigning or unassigning it.

Bed.description: Beds of one kind in a room type, e.g. `{ "kind": "king", "count": 1 }`.

Block.description: A room blocked for `[from, to)`: `to` is the first day it is back.

released.description: Cancelled before it started. Released blocks no longer block anything.

BlockKind.description:
`OutOfOrder` takes the room out of inventory (renovation, construction); `OutOfService` leaves it
sellable and only flags it (a short fix, a deep clean).

BlockReason.description: Why a room is blocked. Each property starts with [`DEFAULT_BLOCK_REASONS`] and may add its own.

BulkChangeRequest.description:
Changes a plan's prices on `[from, to)`. Left out, `weekdays` (ISO: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday),
`room_type_ids` and `occupancies` mean all.

changed.description: How many of the plan's own prices changed.

CancellationPolicy.description: What cancelling or not arriving costs. Reservations (Phase 3) apply it; rate plans name one.

rules.description: Furthest from arrival first; the rule with the fewest days at or above the days left applies.

CancellationRule.description: Cancelling `days_before_arrival` days or fewer before arrival costs `penalty`.

CancelledRoom.description: A cancelled room and what cancelling it cost, in its currency.

ChangeMode.description: How a price is changed: by basis points (`percent`, 1500 = +15 %) or by minor units (`amount`).

released_nights.description: Nights an early departure released back onto the counters, oldest first; empty on a late check-out.

CreateAccountRequest.description: A company or travel agent, and how to reach it.

credit_limit.description: In minor units of `currency`; left out or `null` for no limit.

code.description: Capital letters, digits and `_`, unique within the property. Cannot be changed later.

default_kind.description: The kind the block dialog suggests for this reason.

CreateBlockRequest.description: Blocks the room for `[from, to)`: `to` is the first day it is back in service.

from.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, on or after the property's business date.

to.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, after `from` and at most 730 days after the business date.

rules.description: Each with its own number of days before arrival.

CreateGuestRequest.description: A guest of the tenant, usable by all its properties.

first_name.description: Left out or empty for a guest with a single name.

residency.description: Prices the guest's stays: some plans sell only to residents or only to non-residents.

adult_amount.description: Minor units per adult per night.

child_amount.description: Minor units per child per night.

from.description: The first night it applies to.

meal_plan.description: `BB`, `HB` or `FB`: room only has no supplement.

to.description: The first night it no longer applies to; left out, until further notice.

code.description: 2 to 10 capital letters or digits, unique within the tenant.
Capital letters, digits, `_` and `-`, unique within the property. Cannot be changed later.

currency.description: ISO 4217. A derived plan uses its parent's.

derive_value.description: Derived plans only: basis points (`percent`, -10000 to 100000) or minor units (`amount`).

extra_adult_amount.description: Minor units added per adult above the highest occupancy priced below a stay's. Default 0.

inherit_restrictions.description: Derived plans only: copy the parent's restrictions.

oneOf.description: Left out on a `FIT_F` or `FIT_L` plan, the segment's residency; otherwise any guest.

room_type_ids.description: A derived plan sells a subset of its parent's room types.

rounding_step.description: Minor units; derived and bulk-changed prices are rounded half-up to a multiple of it. Default 1.

CreateReservationRequest.description:
Books every room, confirmed, or none: a night with no room left is 409, and a stay its plan does not sell
(a restriction, a missing price) is 422 with every reason.

account_id.description:
The company or travel agent this reservation is billed to, if any. Must be an active account of this
tenant.

number.description: Letters, digits and `-`, up to 10 characters, unique within the property.

code.description: 1 to 10 capital letters or digits, unique within the property. Cannot be changed later.

overbooking.description: Rooms of this type that may be sold beyond the physical count, 0 to 20.

CreatedReservation.description:
A new reservation. Rooms may be in different currencies, so `totals` has one entry per currency, in the
order the rooms first use them.

CreatedRoom.description: A booked room and what its stay costs, in its plan's currency.

room_id.description:
The room auto-assigned to this stay (`autoassign::pick_room`'s tightest fit), or `None` when no room
of the booked type fit for the whole stay; a stay left unassigned here shows up in Needs a room.
Never a hand-assigned room: only `assign_room` and `modify_room`'s re-assignment can put a stay in a
room a person picked.

version.description: The room's version, for `If-Match` on its commands (cancel, assign, unassign).

Grant.description: A role held tenant-wide (`property_id: None`) or for one property.

Guest.description:
A guest as the API shows it. The ID number appears only masked (`•••• 1234`): the sealed value and its key
id never leave the database, and nothing here decrypts it.

first_name.description: Empty for a guest with a single name.

id_doc_masked.description: The ID number's last 4 characters behind a mask, such as `•••• 1234`.

IdDocRequest.description: An identity document. `Debug` hides the number, which is sealed on arrival and never shown again.

number.description: 1 to 50 characters. Responses show only its last 4 characters behind a mask, such as `•••• 1234`.

IdDocType.description: The kind of identity document a guest showed.

MealPlan.description: Room only, bed and breakfast, half board, full board.

MealSupplement.description:
What a meal plan costs per person per night on top of the room price, in one currency, for the nights
from `from` until `to` (the first night it no longer applies; `None`: until further notice).

room_id.description: The room the stay is in after the change: kept, re-assigned by a type change, or none.

unassigned.description: Whether a type change unassigned the room it had (the old room isn't of the new type).

ModifyRoomRequest.description:
A change to a booked room's stay, type or occupancy. At least one of `check_in`, `check_out`,
`room_type_id`, `adults` or `children` must actually change the room, or `reprice` must be set.

keep_price.description:
Keeps the amounts of nights the new stay still covers even across a type or occupancy change (an
upgrade keeps its price); added nights are always quoted.

reprice.description: Requotes every night of the new stay regardless of what changed.

PenaltyKind.description:
`nights`: that many nights' room price; `percent`: basis points of the stay; `amount`: minor units in
the plan's currency.

PlanKind.description:
`Standard` plans are priced by hand and may have derived plans; `Derived` plans are priced from their
parent by a formula; `Custom` plans are priced by hand and stand alone.

PriceChangeMode.description:
A bulk change adds basis points (`percent`) or minor units (`amount`) to existing prices, rounded to
the plan's step, or `set`s every selected price to the value.

amount.description: Minor units in the plan's currency.

date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, from the business date for 730 days.

occupancy.description: Adults, 1 to the room type's maximum occupancy.

business_date.description: The property's current trading day. Set to its local today when created; moved only by night audit.

check_in_time.description: Local time guests may check in from, `HH:MM`.

check_out_time.description: Local time guests check out by, `HH:MM`.

depth.description: Levels of plans above this one: 0 for standard and custom plans.

derive_value.description: Basis points (`percent`) or minor units (`amount`); may be negative.

extra_adult_amount.description: Added per adult above the highest occupancy priced below a stay's.

inherit_restrictions.description: Copy the parent's restrictions instead of setting its own.

room_type_ids.description: The room types it sells, in their display order.

rounding_step.description: Derived and bulk-changed prices are rounded half-up to a multiple of this, in minor units.

ids.description: Every id of the collection, in the new display order.

ReservationRoomRequest.description: One room of a booking: a room type on a rate plan and meal plan for `[check_in, check_out)`.

check_in.description: On or after the business date.

check_out.description: The morning the guest leaves, at most 730 days after the business date.

primary_guest_id.description: Who stays in the room; left out, the booker. The room is priced for this guest's residency.

Residency.description: Which guests a plan may be sold to.

RestrictionsRequest.description:
Sets restrictions on every day of `[from, to)`. Left out, `weekdays` (ISO) and `room_type_ids` mean all,
and a restriction field means "leave as it is"; `min_stay` or `max_stay` sent as `null` removes it.

guest.description: The guest just added, masked exactly as [`crate::get_guest`] shows it.

RoomStatus.description:
A `reservation_room`'s status, exactly per the diagram in `docs/specs/phase-3-reservations.md` § State
machine.

Convention: the `db::text_enum!` macro (per-variant `#[serde(rename = "...")]`, `as_str`/`parse`) lives in
`db`, and `domain` must not depend on it (it stays pure). Every variant name here
already lowercases to its database text with `snake_case`, so this instead follows the plainer convention
already used by `identity::Role`: `#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]` plus hand-written `as_str`/`parse`.

overbooking.description:
How many more rooms of this type may be sold than are physically available (0-20). A night is
sellable when `physical - sold - out_of_order + overbooking > 0`; `reservations` applies the rule
wherever a night is sold. [`InventoryDay::available`](crate::InventoryDay::available) stays the plain
physical figure and does not include this allowance.

Section.description: A housekeeping section: a group of rooms one housekeeper looks after.

Segment.description:
Where a plan is sold: foreign (`FIT_F`) or local (`FIT_L`) independent travellers, online travel
agents, travel agent contracts, or the hotel's own booking engine.

SetPricesRequest.description: Prices for a standard or custom plan; derived plans are repriced from them in the same transaction.

ShortenBlockRequest.description:
Ends the block early: the room is back from `to`. Sending the business date releases it now; a date on
or before the block's start cancels it.

to.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, on or after the business date and before the block's current end.

Source.description:
Where a booking came from. Staff create `front_desk`, `phone` and `email` bookings; `ibe` and `channel`
bookings arrive through the booking engine (Phase 9) and channels (Phase 8).

Total.description: The sum of the rooms booked in one currency.

UpdateAccountRequest.description:
Fields left out stay as they are; `email`, `phone`, `address`, `contact_name` and `credit_limit` sent as
`null` are cleared.

UpdateBlockReasonRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are.

active.description: `false` retires the reason: existing blocks keep it, new blocks cannot use it.

UpdateCancellationPolicyRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are; `rules` replaces every rule.

UpdateGuestRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are; `email`, `phone`, `country` and `id_doc` sent as `null` are cleared.

oneOf.description: Replaces the identity document; `null` removes it.

UpdateMealSupplementRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are; `to` sent as `null` makes the supplement open-ended.

UpdateRatePlanRequest.description:
Fields left out stay as they are; `residency` and `cancellation_policy_id` sent as `null` are cleared.
The code, kind and currency never change.

active.description: `false` stops selling the plan; its prices stay.

parent_id.description: Moves a derived plan under another parent; its prices (and inherited restrictions) follow the new one.

UpdateReservationRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are; `account_id` sent as `null` clears it (bills no one).

UpdateRoomRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are; `floor` and `section_id` sent as `null` are cleared.

UpdateRoomTypeRequest.description: Fields left out stay as they are.

active.description: `false` retires the type; it must have no active rooms.

overbooking.description: Rooms of this type that may be sold beyond the physical count, 0 to 20.
